{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Digital Content & Social Media Specialist",
  "description": "Permanent Capital Ventures is a venture studio launching new companies with fully developed technology and infrastructure already in place. We are a fast-growing tech startup building modern solutions to redefine how our industry operates. We move fast, value fresh ideas, and foster a collaborative environment where every team member has a direct impact on our growth.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Content &amp; Social Media Specialist

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Do you know how to turn complex ideas into visually stunning graphics, scroll-stopping videos, and high-converting campaigns?
	We are redefining the future of property through technology.
	We are looking for a highly creative, digitally savvy, and multi-talented Digital Content &amp; Social Media Specialist to elevate our brand presence, engage our online community, and craft compelling narratives across all digital touchpoints.
	This role is ideal for a creative professional who can combine strategy, design, content creation, videography, social media, and digital marketing to deliver content that not only looks great but also drives meaningful engagement and business results.


Key Responsibilities
Content Creation &amp; Strategy:


	Conceptualise, create, edit, and publish compelling content across multiple digital platforms.
	Develop creative content ideas that educate, inform, entertain, and engage our target audience.
	Develop and maintain content calendars aligned with the company&#39;s marketing and business objectives.
	Create content for property showcases, brand campaigns, product features, industry insights, and corporate communications.
	Stay informed about emerging content formats, trends, and digital marketing best practices.


Social Media Management:


	Manage the company&#39;s social media platforms from strategy through execution.
	Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, grow the audience, and drive engagement.
	Schedule and publish content consistently across relevant platforms.
	Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and community interactions.
	Track social media performance and provide regular reports and recommendations for improvement.
	Identify trends and opportunities to increase the company&#39;s visibility and reach.


Graphic Design:


	Independently create high-quality, visually appealing, and on-brand graphics for social media and digital marketing campaigns.
	Design marketing materials, presentations, pitch decks, promotional materials, and other visual assets as required.
	Maintain consistency in the company&#39;s visual identity across all digital platforms.
	Translate complex concepts and information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling designs.


Videography &amp; Video Production:


	Handle end-to-end video production, including concept development, filming, editing, and publishing.
	Produce engaging short-form and long-form video content for social media and other digital channels.
	Create videos for property showcases, technology features, educational content, interviews, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
	Edit videos to a high professional standard, incorporating appropriate graphics, transitions, captions, music, and other elements.
	Stay current with emerging video formats and trends, particularly short-form content.


Email Marketing:


	Plan, create, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns and newsletters.
	Develop engaging email copy and visual content designed to generate engagement and conversions.
	Manage email lists and audience segmentation where required.
	Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics to improve future campaigns.
	Support lead nurturing and client engagement through effective email communication.


Mandatory Requirements


	Minimum of 3 years of hands-on professional experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or a related multidisciplinary role.
	Demonstrated professional experience in social media management.
	Strong practical experience in email marketing and campaign management.
	Proven graphic design skills with the ability to independently produce high-quality visual content.
	Proven videography and video editing skills.
	Strong ability to create engaging, original, and platform-specific content.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and conceptualisation skills.
	A strong portfolio demonstrating previous graphic design, video production, social media, and content creation work.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Platforms &amp; Tools:
The successful candidate should be comfortable working with relevant digital platforms and tools, including:


	Social Media: LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and X.
	Design: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, and/or Figma.
	Video: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve.
	Email Marketing: Mailchimp, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Constant Contact, or similar platforms.
	Social Media Management &amp; Analytics: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and other relevant analytics or scheduling tools.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume and Portfolio (including video editing and graphic design samples) to: Support@perma-capital.com using the&nbsp;&nbsp;Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Ready to build the future of proptech marketing with us? Apply.
	Candidates are not necessarily required to have experience with every tool listed, but must demonstrate strong proficiency with relevant industry-standard platforms.

Digital Content & Social Media Specialist Job at Permanent Capital Ventures




        
    

        
        Permanent Capital Ventures is a venture studio launching new companies with fully developed technology and infrastructure already in place. We are a fast-growing tech startup building modern solutions to redefine how our industry operates. We move fast, value fresh ideas, and foster a collaborative environment where every team member has a direct impact on our growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Content & Social Media Specialist

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Do you know how to turn complex ideas into visually stunning graphics, scroll-stopping videos, and high-converting campaigns?
	We are redefining the future of property through technology.
	We are looking for a highly creative, digitally savvy, and multi-talented Digital Content & Social Media Specialist to elevate our brand presence, engage our online community, and craft compelling narratives across all digital touchpoints.
	This role is ideal for a creative professional who can combine strategy, design, content creation, videography, social media, and digital marketing to deliver content that not only looks great but also drives meaningful engagement and business results.


Key Responsibilities
Content Creation & Strategy:


	Conceptualise, create, edit, and publish compelling content across multiple digital platforms.
	Develop creative content ideas that educate, inform, entertain, and engage our target audience.
	Develop and maintain content calendars aligned with the company's marketing and business objectives.
	Create content for property showcases, brand campaigns, product features, industry insights, and corporate communications.
	Stay informed about emerging content formats, trends, and digital marketing best practices.


Social Media Management:


	Manage the company's social media platforms from strategy through execution.
	Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, grow the audience, and drive engagement.
	Schedule and publish content consistently across relevant platforms.
	Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and community interactions.
	Track social media performance and provide regular reports and recommendations for improvement.
	Identify trends and opportunities to increase the company's visibility and reach.


Graphic Design:


	Independently create high-quality, visually appealing, and on-brand graphics for social media and digital marketing campaigns.
	Design marketing materials, presentations, pitch decks, promotional materials, and other visual assets as required.
	Maintain consistency in the company's visual identity across all digital platforms.
	Translate complex concepts and information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling designs.


Videography & Video Production:


	Handle end-to-end video production, including concept development, filming, editing, and publishing.
	Produce engaging short-form and long-form video content for social media and other digital channels.
	Create videos for property showcases, technology features, educational content, interviews, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
	Edit videos to a high professional standard, incorporating appropriate graphics, transitions, captions, music, and other elements.
	Stay current with emerging video formats and trends, particularly short-form content.


Email Marketing:


	Plan, create, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns and newsletters.
	Develop engaging email copy and visual content designed to generate engagement and conversions.
	Manage email lists and audience segmentation where required.
	Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics to improve future campaigns.
	Support lead nurturing and client engagement through effective email communication.


Mandatory Requirements


	Minimum of 3 years of hands-on professional experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or a related multidisciplinary role.
	Demonstrated professional experience in social media management.
	Strong practical experience in email marketing and campaign management.
	Proven graphic design skills with the ability to independently produce high-quality visual content.
	Proven videography and video editing skills.
	Strong ability to create engaging, original, and platform-specific content.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and conceptualisation skills.
	A strong portfolio demonstrating previous graphic design, video production, social media, and content creation work.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Platforms & Tools:
The successful candidate should be comfortable working with relevant digital platforms and tools, including:


	Social Media: LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and X.
	Design: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, and/or Figma.
	Video: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve.
	Email Marketing: Mailchimp, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Constant Contact, or similar platforms.
	Social Media Management & Analytics: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and other relevant analytics or scheduling tools.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume and Portfolio (including video editing and graphic design samples) to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Ready to build the future of proptech marketing with us? Apply.
	Candidates are not necessarily required to have experience with every tool listed, but must demonstrate strong proficiency with relevant industry-standard platforms.

Account Officer Job at Atis Limited




        
    

        
        At Atis Limited, our vision is to be the leading real estate consultancy in Nigeria. Delivering quality, strategic and Commercial solutions to occupiers and investors. Our values are Excellence, Integrity and Professionalism combined with energy and Innovation. We focus on development of a lasting business relationship that transcends in real estate transaction. Our priorities are the development of strategies and effective implementation of transactions to ensure that corporate objectives are met.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Officer

Job Location: Lagos Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all financial transactions including income, expenses, and bank dealings.
	Prepare and maintain accurate financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements.
	Ensure all financial records are compliant with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and relevant financial regulations.
	Monitor and reconcile client accounts, vendor accounts, and bank statements regularly.
	Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
	Track expenditures for facility operations and maintenance contracts to ensure alignment with budget.
	Ensure timely payment of utilities, vendor invoices, and statutory obligations.
	Support internal and external audits by providing required financial documents.
	Assist in the preparation of budgets and forecasts.
	Maintain documentation for financial processes and ensure compliance with company policies.
	Support other finance functions as needed


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role
	Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, Excel).
	Strong knowledge of basic accounting principles and practices.
	High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and integrity.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


Salary
N350,000 / Month.

	The IPP Plant Manager is responsible for the overall management, operation, and maintenance of Independent Power Plants (IPP) within Bayshore Technologies&rsquo; Power as a Service and Power Solutions verticals.
	This role ensures that the plant operates efficiently, maintains high uptime, and meets contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with customers.

Power Plant Operations &amp; Performance Optimization:


	Ensure 98%+ uptime of power generation as per SLA agreements.
	Monitor and optimize fuel efficiency, ensuring adherence to contractually agreed consumption rates (e.g., 3.6 KWH per SCM with Mantrac).
	Oversee day-to-day operations, maintenance, and troubleshooting of power generation assets.
	Ensure power distribution infrastructure is preventively and correctively maintained to avoid downtime.

	Develop and implement a preventive maintenance program to minimize power distribution failures.
	Ensure all transformers, switchgear, and distribution lines are in optimal working condition.
	Work closely with suppliers and vendors to ensure rapid response times for corrective maintenance.


Compliance with ISO 45001 &amp; ISO 9001 Standards:


	Ensure continuous compliance with ISO 45001 (Health &amp; Safety) and ISO 9001 (Quality Management).
	Conduct regular internal audits and coordinate with external auditors for certification renewals.
	Train plant personnel on safety best practices and ensure zero safety incidents.

	Optimize operational expenses while ensuring reliable power generation.
	Monitor fuel costs, negotiate supply contracts, and reduce inefficiencies in energy conversion.
	Monitor financial performance of plant operations.

	Provide quarterly market intelligence reports on power generation trends, regulatory changes, and technological advancements.
	Submit weekly/monthly performance reports detailing uptime, fuel consumption, maintenance activities, and compliance updates.
	Analyze competitor strategies and recommend improvements for Bayshore&rsquo;s IPP business.

	Strong knowledge of power generation technologies, CNG fuel efficiency, and distribution infrastructure.
	Excellent leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
	Proficiency in contract management, regulatory compliance, and financial oversight.
	Strong analytical skills with experience in status reporting and market intelligence gathering.


Remuneration
Open (Based on experience).

Logistics Lead Job at TalentForge Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        TalentForge Solutions Limited - Our client in the Logistics industry is recruiting qualified and results-driven candidates to fill the position below: 

Shipping& Logistics

Job Position: Logistics Lead

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: COO
Mode of Work: Onsite

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Logistics Lead is responsible for building,  managing, and scaling a high-performance supply and distribution operation.
	This role owns the end-to-end logistics and commercial cycle, including supplier  management, working capital efficiency, dispatch operations, delivery performance, collections discipline, and team leadership.
	The successful candidate will drive operational excellence, improve profitability through stronger supplier relationships and optimized distribution processes, and establish scalable systems that support sustainable business growth.


Job Responsibilities


	Develop and strengthen supplier, distributor, and strategic partner relationships to improve pricing, allocation, and supply reliability.
	Identify opportunities to expand and strengthen distribution capabilities and market reach.
	Negotiate commercial terms that improve margins and operational performance.
	Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and distribution opportunities to support business growth.
	Own and manage the working capital cycle to ensure efficient inventory movement and cash flow.
	Maintain strict payment and collections discipline to protect cash velocity and business profitability.
	Monitor margins, costs, and operational performance to achieve volume and profitability targets.
	Collaborate with leadership to establish and execute growth strategies that improve financial outcomes.
	Oversee daily logistics operations, including order processing, dispatch, transportation, and delivery activities.
	Manage fleet performance and third-party haulage providers to ensure efficient and reliable service delivery.
	Establish and maintain operational standards, processes, and controls that improve efficiency and reduce risk.
	Monitor delivery performance and implement corrective actions to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
	Recruit, lead, coach, and develop logistics and operational support teams.
	Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and operational excellence.


Job Requirements


	Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, distribution, commercial operations, or a related field.
	Demonstrated experience managing transportation, dispatch, delivery, fleet operations, or distribution networks.
	Proven track record of achieving operational, financial, or commercial performance targets.
	Experience managing budgets, margins, working capital, or profit-and-loss responsibilities is highly desirable.
	Experience within building materials, manufacturing, FMCG, wholesale distribution, or related industries is an advantage.


Salary
N500,000 / Month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Logistics Lead - Abuja" as the subject of the email. 

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
